name: How long does it take to complete a bathroom addition?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to complete a bathroom addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a bathroom addition varies based on complexity, size, and material availability. A small half-bath addition might take 4-6 weeks, while a larger master bathroom addition with custom features could extend to 8-12 weeks or more. Factors like permit approval times in specific municipalities like Dublin or Pleasanton can also influence the overall schedule. We provide a detailed project timeline after the initial design consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Bathroom additions can take 4-12 weeks or longer, depending on size, complexity, and permit approvals.
